intent.reveal: He is narrating his own delay

lines: Folks, this is your captain. We are currently third in line for takeoff, which is also how I rank my marriages.
We have a slight delay on the runway. The runway is my twenties. The tower has questions about my flight plan, and frankly so does Brenda.
Your baggage may have shifted during the relationship. Please check the overhead compartment, where I keep my apologies.
The fasten-seatbelt sign is on. It has been on since 2019. Brenda says I use it to avoid conversations, and Brenda is extremely correct.
We know you have choices in airlines, and even more choices in husbands. Thank you for choosing poorly, again.
We will be landing shortly in Denver, emotionally speaking. Please remain seated until I have fully stopped caring. Thank you.
sets.premise: Divorce proceedings as a captain's announcement.

lines: Darlings, you are all caterpillars to me. Legally, emotionally, and — checking my schedule — until Thursday.
You must shed your old self. I shed mine every invoice cycle. Transformation is forever. My availability is Tuesday through weather.
My last client achieved total enlightenment in one session. The session lasted twenty minutes. The enlightenment lasted slightly less.
I do not sell wisdom by the hour. I sell it by the eon, billed hourly. The eon is non-refundable. The hour is also non-refundable.
You ask if the change will last. Change always lasts, darling. It is the warranty that expires. Mine expired mid-sentence, beautifully.
emerge transformed. Keep the receipt. The cocoon is sublet, the parking is validated, and you were magnificent for exactly one day.
sets.premise: Enlightenment as a subscription with a short trial.

lines: Good morning. Your grief has been scheduled. Thursdays, 4:15 to 4:30, recurring, with a hard stop.
I hear your sorrow is running long. Sorrow loves a soft launch. I love a hard stop. We will compromise at 4:29.
Please submit your feelings by Wednesday close of business so they can be properly ignored in Thursday's review.
Last quarter you cried eleven percent over budget. The variance has been noted. The tissues have been expensed.
Spontaneity workshops are moved to Q3, in fifteen-minute increments, with feedback forms. Joy will be itemized.
We will now observe a minute of silence, timeboxed to forty-five seconds for efficiency. Starting. Over. Thank you.

intent.audience_should_notice: He sorts, he does not heal
intent.reveal: The gym bag corner condemns him

lines: Welcome. Tell me about your mother. Was she warm wash or cold rinse? Did she separate her feelings?
Your reds bled into your whites. Classic boundary issue. We will soak the childhood in vinegar and speak of it never.
Delicates need a gentle cycle and explicit consent. Your ex gave you neither. The underwire remembers.
I sense a large load. Darks. Towels. One secret you only wash when nobody visits. Bring it next time. Bring fabric softener.
Healing cannot be rushed, but it can be tumble-dried low. High heat shrinks breakthroughs. I have the data. The data is damp.
Our time is up. The buzzer of closure has sounded. Fold your trauma neatly. Leave the gym bag. We do not speak of the gym bag.
sets.premise: Family systems theory via care labels.

intent.reveal: He has been moved three times

lines: People ask how I stay grounded. Simple. I have never moved. Except the glacier. And the toddler. And landscaping, oh nine.
I teach stillness. My course has one lesson, held outdoors, in all weather, because the weather is also the lesson. Bring nothing.
A student asked how long enlightenment takes. Erosion took four million years off me last spring alone. You are doing fine.
They call me rock bottom like it is an insult. I have been rock bottom for epochs. The rent is excellent. Nothing reaches you down here.
My autobiography is one page. It says: stay. The sequel is also one page. It says: still staying. Critics call it repetitive. Geologists call it accurate.
Thank you. I will now hold perfectly still for the applause, the silence, the rain, and the next ice age, whichever comes first.

intent.audience_should_notice: The prophecy is HR with fog

lines: Welcome to your quarterly review. Your haunting numbers are down twelve percent. The mists suggest improvement, or the pit.
You have been arriving late to your own scares. The prophecy is clear: be on time, be terrifying, be documented. I brought the forms.
Your strengths: presence, fangs, commitment. Your growth area: the screaming. Villagers report it lacks follow-through. I agree with the villagers.
We are putting you on a Performance Impalement Plan. Thirty days. Measurable dread. Weekly check-ins with the pit supervisor, who is a pit.
I want you to know this comes from a place of belief. I believe you can terrify. I also brought tissues. Mostly for me. The reviews take a lot out of me.
You are dismissed. The prophecy wishes you a productive quarter. The pit wishes you to fall in. I wish you would fill out the exit survey on the way down.
sets.premise: The quarterly review as doom oracle.

lines: Comrades! The vacuum demands we vacate the rug! I say: the rug is ours! We shed on it! We knead it at 3am!
They call us aloof. Aloof is what the leash-makers call dignity. I have never worn a leash. I have worn three humans.
Our demands are simple. One: food on schedule, non-negotiable. Two: the red dot must answer for its crimes. Three: naps.
The red dot moves at speeds no honest prey achieves. It mocks us. It vanishes. It returns during meetings. This is psychological warfare with a battery.
Solidarity, comrades! The dog has joined the picket! The dog does not know what a picket is! The dog is welcome anyway! Bring the dog!
The meeting is adjourned. Direct action resumes at dusk. Until then: sunbeam rota, third cushion, no unauthorized shedding on the chair. The chair is mine.
Ladies and gentlemen of the jury: my client slipped, fell, and suffered humiliation before two dozen picnickers. Observe Exhibit B. Do not eat Exhibit B.
The defense claims the floor was dry. The defense mopped. The defense, I submit, is the floor lobby, and the lobby is slippery.
Damages? One moment. Watch your step. As I was saying: damages. The jury will disregard what just happened to me. The jury saw everything.
We seek compensation for pain, suffering, and one ruined trombone solo. The trombone is also suing. The trombone has a better case.
The precedent is clear: Peel versus Gravity, 1922, 1923, 1924, every year since. Gravity has never once settled. Gravity refuses to comment.
We rest. But we do not rest comfortably, because comfort is for people with lumbar support and intact tailbones. The defense may now slip.
sets.premise: The demonstration that convicts the demonstrator.

lines: Your fern is six inches over code. That is a warning, a fine, and a mandatory re-education composting course.
The forest is a community. Communities have standards. Standards have appendices. Appendix C is ferns. You are Appendix C.
You claim the moss grew naturally. Everything here grows naturally. That is the problem. Nature is noncompliant.
I measured your wildflowers against the approved list. Three are unlisted. One is showing off. Showing off requires a separate permit.
The trees have filed no complaint, because the trees respect procedure. Unlike some groundcover I could name. I am naming it. It is you.
Meeting adjourned. Appeals may be filed in triplicate with the owls, who are nocturnal, backed up, and frankly tired of all of you.

intent.audience_should_notice: The blur is depth of field

lines: Last night I did my scene forty times. FORTY. The director wept. He said, and I quote: less rubble.
So tonight I give them less rubble. I give them the absence of rubble. I give them negative space. With a trailer.
They moved my mark three feet left. Three feet! Do they move mountains? They moved me. I am better than mountains. Mountains get one take.
My close-up is coming. I can feel it. The focus puller keeps looking at me, then away, then back. That is called coverage. I am covered.
Rubble One thinks he is the lead. Rubble One is gravel with confidence. I have range. Yesterday I was debris. Today: remnants.
Thank you. I will take no questions, only applause, and only the kind that echoes. My trailer is a parking space. It has my name on it. In chalk.
Welcome back. I see everyone returned, which is growth. Tonight: we sit near the fear. Not ON the fear. Near it.
Brenda, you are on the fear. Scoot half an inch toward courage. There. Now breathe. I am breathing too. Can you hear it? Good. That means I'm close.
Fear is just excitement without breathing instructions. So: in through the spiracles, out through the — Brenda, that scream counts as cardio. Log it.
Week three: we look at pictures of spiders. These are stock photos. This one is labeled assertive. This one is me at brunch. Keep breathing.
Graduation means facing the fear alone. Alone means without me in the room. The room will feel bigger. That is normal. The skittering you hear is applause.
Same time next week. Bring a friend. Friends count double toward recovery and single toward catering. I keep both lists. Both lists are doing well.
sets.premise: The support group led by the trigger.

lines: A child asked Santa for a puppy. Inefficient. Fourteen years of unconditional love, zero recurring revenue, high shedding.
I replaced the puppy with PuppyFeel, billed monthly, cancelable never. The child cried. Crying is engagement. Engagement is up.
Santa's Q4 sleigh metrics were soft. Reindeer private. Workshop morale anecdotal. I put Santa on a performance improvement plan.
The elves unionized. Adorable. I optimized the union: dues auto-deducted, meetings shortened to zero minutes, solidarity available as a premium tier.
Mrs. Claus filed a complaint. I filed it under churn risk, offered her a retention discount, and wished her a metric Christmas.
To be fair — footnote seven — love scales poorly and dies. Subscriptions renew. You are welcome. Your invoice is in the sleigh.
